notes.title: Inferni - Balance Changes 13/06/24
notes.notes:
Here are the latest balance updates for Inferni: Hope & Fear. As the game is still in active development, expect more changes in the future.

Features


 Added codex to start screen.


General Gameplay


 Starting life decreased from 100 to 90 HP.
 Final round time increased from 150 seconds to 180 seconds.


Card Changes

Absorb Sphere

 Duration time reduced from 20 seconds to 15 seconds.
 Absorb amount decreased from 10 HP to 5 HP


Lightning

 Damage increased from 5 HP to 7 HP.


Spark

 Damage increased from 3 HP to 5 HP.


Dying Breathe

 Minimum life to cast from 20 HP to 30 HP.
 Damage increased from 15 HP to 20 HP.


Charm Changes

Leech Brooch

 Damage gain from 25% to 15%.


Paper Heart Locket

 Life gain to draw a card increased from 1 HP to 10 HP.


Healing Balm Vial

 Added. Reads: “Whenever you take damage, heal 20 life. Then Healing Balm Vial is destroyed.”


Soul Link Stone

 Reworded (“Every 5 seconds: For each ally with less life you lose 1 life and they gain 1 life.”)


Character Changes

Panacea
Charms

 Removed Leech Brooch, added Soul Link Stone.

Deck

 Removed 1 x Absorb Sphere.
 Removed 1 x Lightning Surge.
 Add 2 x Gift of Friendship.


Trickster Demon
Deck

 Removed 2 x Lightning Surge.
 Removed 1 x Revive.
 Added 1 x Smelt.
 Added 1 x Double Down.
 Added 1 x Value Crash.


Leather Man
Deck

 Removed 2 x Healing Wind.
 Removed 1 x Dying Breathe.
 Added 1 x Deal with the Devil.
 Added 1 x Become Death.
 Added 1 x Healing Storm.


Modifier Changes

Sting

 Renamed to ‘Rage’.


These updates are based on feedback from playtesting. We encourage players to join our public playtests to help us balance the game before launch.

To participate, please join our Discord community.

Thanks for reading!

Team Village

notes.title: Inferni - Balance Changes 30/05/24
notes.notes:
Here are the latest balance updates for Inferni: Hope & Fear. As the game is still in active development, expect more changes in the future.

General Gameplay


 Starting life increased from 70 to 100 HP.
 Hail Storm damage rate decreased from 0.25 HP/s to 0.1 HP/s.
 Downed time extended from 30 seconds to 45 seconds.


Card Changes

Growing Hate

 Casting time reduced from 10 seconds to 5 seconds.
 Airborne damage growth rate reduced from 1 damage per second to 1 damage per 2 seconds.


Growing Dislike

 Casting time reduced from 5 seconds to 3 seconds.
 Airborne damage growth rate reduced from 1 damage per 2 seconds to 1 damage per 3 seconds.


Bounce

 Casting time reduced from 1 second to instant.


Lightning

 Casting time reduced from 5 seconds to 3 seconds.


Reflection

 Renamed to 'Mirror'.


Rot Out

 Casting time increased from 3 seconds to 5 seconds.


Sanctity Sphere

 Renamed to 'Absorb Sphere'.
 Buff duration increased from 10 seconds to 20 seconds.


Smelt

 Casting time increased from 3 seconds to 5 seconds.


Spark

 Casting time reduced from 2 seconds to instant.


Thunderstorm

 Casting time reduced from 15 seconds to 10 seconds.


Smite

 Damage reduced from 10 HP to 8 HP.


Slow Time

 Card removed from the game.


Moment of Peace

 Card removed from the game.


Classes

Madame Futura

 Moment of Peace replaced with Cloak.


These updates are based on feedback from playtesting. We encourage players to join our public playtests to help us balance the game before launch.

To participate, please join our Discord community.

Thanks for reading!

Team Village
